tool: Yi30 Wan2.2 W4A8 SVDQuant NVIDIA artifacts

criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: The 5B base and packaged artifact support image-conditioned video; exact ASIN preservation and first-10-seconds identity are untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Publisher sample files and trajectory similarity are not AIVP hands-on visual-quality evidence.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Seed, steps, resolution and precomputed quantization artifacts are documented; three-run visual repeatability is untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Download and vLLM-Omni commands are documented, but the route requires a specialized CUDA environment and separate base components.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: No AIVP timing, queue, error-rate or creator-hardware reliability artifacts.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: No model fee is documented, but compute, electricity, setup and cost per accepted output are unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Repository and referenced base model declare Apache-2.0.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: A deterministic CLI path through vLLM-Omni is documented; no audited AIVP MCP/API integration exists.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Public artifacts are geographically accessible, but 26.3GB measured minimum peak memory is outside common creator hardware.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate programme or proven high-intent creator buying path found.

analysis: Technically relevant image-conditioned NVIDIA quantization artifacts, but not a new generation model and not executable on AIVP's current host. Exact-product fidelity, output quality, reliability and true cost remain unverified.
confidence_notes: Primary repository, upstream model and implementation evidence only; no AIVP run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Blocked pending three-run exact-product first-frame/first-10-seconds success.
hard_gates.publication: First Look only; full Review blocked pending hands-on evidence.
hard_gates.integration: Blocked: current host has no NVIDIA GPU and paid compute is not approved.
